---
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      validation_only:
        description: Run the complete release validation without publishing a crate, tag, or release.
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deterministic:
    name: Complete deterministic validation
    if: github.repository == 'Strukturpiloten/quadlet-lens'
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      statuses: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci.yml
    with:
      api_purpose: published

  native-generator-validation:
    name: Complete pinned native generator validation
    if: github.repository == 'Strukturpiloten/quadlet-lens'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/generator-matrix.yml
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      task: release-native-generator

  release-metadata:
    name: Validate release metadata
    if: github.repository == 'Strukturpiloten/quadlet-lens'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      candidate_sha: ${{ steps.verified.outputs.candidate_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact release revision
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install configured Rust toolchain
        run: rustup show active-toolchain
      - name: Validate release branch, version, and notes
        id: verified
        shell: bash
        env:
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "${GITHUB_REF}" != "refs/heads/${DEFAULT_BRANCH}" ]]; then
            echo "Run releases from the default branch (${DEFAULT_BRANCH})." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          bash scripts/check-release-metadata.sh --release
          printf 'candidate_sha=%s\n' "${GITHUB_SHA}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

  native-generator-evidence:
    name: Exact-SHA native generator evidence
    needs: native-generator-validation
    if: always() && github.repository == 'Strukturpiloten/quadlet-lens'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    outputs:
      candidate_sha: ${{ steps.verified.outputs.candidate_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Download current-run native-generator evidence
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.native-generator-validation.outputs.evidence_artifact }}
          path: target/release-evidence
      - name: Require successful exact candidate evidence
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_TASK: release-native-generator
          NATIVE_RESULT: ${{ needs.native-generator-validation.result }}
          NATIVE_CANDIDATE: ${{ needs.native-generator-validation.outputs.candidate_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${NATIVE_RESULT}" = success
          test "${NATIVE_CANDIDATE}" = "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          evidence=target/release-evidence/native-generator-v1.json
          jq --exit-status \
            --arg revision "${GITHUB_SHA}" \
            --arg run_id "${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
            --arg task "${EXPECTED_TASK}" \
            '.schema == 1 and .revision == $revision and .run_id == $run_id and
             .task == $task and .result == "success" and .generator_lane == "full" and
             .application_lane == "tracked-current" and .outer_runtime.schema == 1 and
             .outer_runtime.engine == "podman" and .outer_runtime.rootless == false and
             .outer_runtime.remote == false and .outer_runtime.timeout_self_control.result == "passed" and
             .outer_runtime.timeout_self_control.uid == 0 and
             .outer_runtime.timeout_self_control.descendants == "sigkill-reaped" and
             (.outer_runtime.version | type) == "string" and
             (.outer_runtime.package | type) == "string"' \
            "${evidence}" >/dev/null
      - name: Retain release native-generator evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-native-generator-evidence-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: target/release-evidence/native-generator-v1.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 90

      - name: Expose verified native evidence candidate
        id: verified
        shell: bash
        run: printf 'candidate_sha=%s\n' "${GITHUB_SHA}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  release-gate:
    name: Fail-closed release validation gate
    needs: [deterministic, native-generator-validation, native-generator-evidence, release-metadata]
    if: always() && github.repository == 'Strukturpiloten/quadlet-lens'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-release-validation.yml@1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
      policy_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      config_path: .github/release-policy.json
      needs_json: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
  crate-preparation:
    name: Read-only crate publication preparation
    needs: release-gate
    if: github.repository == 'Strukturpiloten/quadlet-lens'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared release automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind release candidate and typed policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          policy-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          config-path: .github/release-policy.json
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Install configured Rust toolchain
        working-directory: source
        run: rustup show active-toolchain
      - name: Validate publication inventory without credentials
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-crate-publish
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          release-config: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          package: quadlet-lens
          validation-sha: ${{ needs.release-gate.outputs.candidate_sha }}
          validation-result: ${{ needs.release-gate.result }}
          validation-only: "true"
  release:
    name: Publish QuadletLens
    needs:
      [
        deterministic,
        native-generator-validation,
        native-generator-evidence,
        release-metadata,
        release-gate,
        crate-preparation,
      ]
    if: github.repository == 'Strukturpiloten/quadlet-lens' && !inputs.validation_only
    environment: release
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      RELEASE_GITHUB_API_VERSION: "2026-03-10"
    permissions:
      artifact-metadata: write # Record artifact attestations for the packaged crate.
      attestations: write # Sign the packaged crate's provenance attestation.
      contents: write # Create the release tag and GitHub release.
      id-token: write # Authenticate attestations and crates.io trusted publishing.
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared release automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind release candidate and typed policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          policy-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          config-path: .github/release-policy.json
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Install configured Rust toolchain
        working-directory: source
        run: rustup show active-toolchain

      - name: Derive release publication metadata
        id: metadata
        shell: bash
        working-directory: source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          version="$(
            cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 |
              jq -er '.packages[] | select(.name == "quadlet-lens") | .version'
          )"
          tag="v${version}"
          notes="${RUNNER_TEMP}/quadlet-lens-release-notes-${version}.md"
          crate="target/package/quadlet-lens-${version}.crate"

          if ! bash scripts/extract-release-notes.sh "${version}" > "${notes}"; then
            echo "CHANGELOG.md does not contain usable release notes for ${version}." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          {
            printf 'version=%s\n' "${version}"
            printf 'tag=%s\n' "${tag}"
            printf 'notes=%s\n' "${notes}"
            printf 'crate=%s\n' "${crate}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Build release package and checksum
        shell: bash
        env:
          CRATE: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.crate }}
        working-directory: source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo ci-package
          sha256sum "${CRATE}" > "${CRATE}.sha256"

      - name: Attest release package
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: source/${{ steps.metadata.outputs.crate }}

      - name: Create or verify annotated release tag
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.tag }}
        working-directory: source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if git ls-remote --exit-code origin "refs/tags/${TAG}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            git fetch --force origin "refs/tags/${TAG}:refs/tags/${TAG}"
            tagged_commit="$(git rev-list -n 1 "${TAG}")"
            if [[ "${tagged_commit}" != "${GITHUB_SHA}" ]]; then
              echo "${TAG} already points to ${tagged_commit}, not ${GITHUB_SHA}." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            tag_object_sha="$(
              gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/tags" \
                --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${RELEASE_GITHUB_API_VERSION}" \
                -f tag="${TAG}" \
                -f message="QuadletLens ${TAG}" \
                -f object="${GITHUB_SHA}" \
                -f type=commit \
                --jq '.sha'
            )"
            gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/refs" \
              --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${RELEASE_GITHUB_API_VERSION}" \
              -f ref="refs/tags/${TAG}" \
              -f sha="${tag_object_sha}"
          fi

      - name: Create or replace draft GitHub release
        id: release
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          NOTES: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.notes }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.version }}
        working-directory: source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          release_name="QuadletLens ${VERSION}"
          releases="$(
            gh api --paginate \
              --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${RELEASE_GITHUB_API_VERSION}" \
              "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases?per_page=100" |
              jq --slurp '[.[][]]'
          )"
          published_count="$(
            jq --raw-output --arg tag "${TAG}" \
              '[.[] | select(.draft == false and .tag_name == $tag)] | length' \
              <<< "${releases}"
          )"
          if [[ "${published_count}" != "0" ]]; then
            echo "${TAG} is already associated with a published GitHub release." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          drafts="$(
            jq --arg name "${release_name}" --arg tag "${TAG}" \
              '[.[] |
                select(
                  .draft == true and
                  (.tag_name == $tag or .name == $name)
                )
              ]' \
              <<< "${releases}"
          )"
          draft_count="$(jq --raw-output 'length' <<< "${drafts}")"

          case "${draft_count}" in
            0)
              ;;
            1)
              previous_release_id="$(jq --exit-status --raw-output '.[0].id' <<< "${drafts}")"
              gh api --method DELETE \
                --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${RELEASE_GITHUB_API_VERSION}" \
                "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/${previous_release_id}"
              ;;
            *)
              echo "Found ${draft_count} possible workflow drafts for ${TAG}; refusing to choose one." >&2
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

          release="$(
            jq --null-input \
              --rawfile body "${NOTES}" \
              --arg name "${release_name}" \
              --arg tag "${TAG}" \
              --arg target "${GITHUB_SHA}" \
              '{
                tag_name: $tag,
                target_commitish: $target,
                name: $name,
                body: $body,
                draft: true,
                prerelease: false
              }' |
              gh api --method POST \
                --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${RELEASE_GITHUB_API_VERSION}" \
                "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases" \
                --input -
          )"
          release_id="$(jq --exit-status --raw-output '.id' <<< "${release}")"
          upload_url="$(
            jq --exit-status --raw-output \
              '.upload_url | sub("\\{\\?name,label\\}$"; "")' \
              <<< "${release}"
          )"
          expected_upload_url="https://uploads.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/${release_id}/assets"
          if [[ "${upload_url}" != "${expected_upload_url}" ]]; then
            echo "GitHub returned an unexpected release asset upload URL." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          printf 'release_id=%s\n' "${release_id}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          printf 'upload_url=%s\n' "${upload_url}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Upload draft GitHub release assets
        shell: bash
        env:
          CRATE: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.crate }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_ID: ${{ steps.release.outputs.release_id }}
          UPLOAD_URL: ${{ steps.release.outputs.upload_url }}
        working-directory: source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          upload_asset() {
            local asset_path="$1"
            local content_type="$2"
            local asset_name="${asset_path##*/}"
            local response

            test -f "${asset_path}"
            if [[ ! "${asset_name}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]]; then
              echo "Unsafe release asset name: ${asset_name}" >&2
              return 1
            fi

            response="$(
              curl --proto '=https' \
                --tlsv1.2 \
                --fail-with-body \
                --silent \
                --show-error \
                --connect-timeout 10 \
                --max-time 120 \
                --request POST \
                --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
                --header "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}" \
                --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${RELEASE_GITHUB_API_VERSION}" \
                --header "Content-Type: ${content_type}" \
                --data-binary "@${asset_path}" \
                "${UPLOAD_URL}?name=${asset_name}"
            )"
            jq --exit-status --arg name "${asset_name}" \
              '.name == $name and .state == "uploaded" and (.id | type == "number")' \
              <<< "${response}" >/dev/null
          }

          expected_upload_url="https://uploads.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/${RELEASE_ID}/assets"
          if [[ "${UPLOAD_URL}" != "${expected_upload_url}" ]]; then
            echo "Release asset upload URL does not match the created release." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          upload_asset "${CRATE}" "application/gzip"
          upload_asset "${CRATE}.sha256" "text/plain"

      - name: Publish crate through shared trusted publishing
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-crate-publish
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          release-config: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          package: quadlet-lens
          validation-sha: ${{ needs.release-gate.outputs.candidate_sha }}
          validation-result: ${{ needs.release-gate.result }}
          validation-only: "false"
      - name: Publish immutable GitHub release
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_ID: ${{ steps.release.outputs.release_id }}
        working-directory: source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          jq --null-input '{draft: false, make_latest: "true"}' |
            gh api --method PATCH \
              --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${RELEASE_GITHUB_API_VERSION}" \
              "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/${RELEASE_ID}" \
              --input - \
              --jq 'if .draft == false then .html_url
                    else error("GitHub release remained a draft") end'
